discoverability.description: Replaceable identity-provider packs that give a generated project its own end-user sign-in population. The packs are independent processes behind the forge-identity-provider/1.0 JSON-lines contract, so no provider vendor is bound into Forge Core or into an application.
use_cases: give a generated project its own end-user sign-in population
trial a local identity provider without binding a vendor
replace one identity provider pack with another without touching the application
search_phrases: local keycloak sign-in for a generated project
